title: Crypto Carry
authors: Maik Schmeling; Andreas Schrimpf; Karamfil Todorov
eligible_reason: Asset-pricing paper; time-series and exchange-panel regressions of crypto futures basis. The only DiD-type regressions are two separate single-event comparisons (CME vs other exchanges around the May 3, 2021 micro-Bitcoin futures launch and the January 9, 2024 BTC ETF approval), each with one treated unit, one-month windows, pooled OLS (plm model='pooling'). Not staggered and no unit FE.
design_notes: R. Figures_and_Tables.R lines 1000-1034: Post = Date > event_date, Treat = exc=='CME'; plm(b1m ~ Treat + Post + Treat*Post, index=c('exc','Date'), model='pooling') with double-clustered (vcovDC) SEs; one column adds eth_r. Other regressions: lm of basis on Google trends, momentum, open interest, liquidations; plm twoways of basis on funding-rate spreads and VIX.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Each event regression has one event date and one treated exchange (CME).

specs.exclusion_reason: single event date, one treated unit, no unit/time FE
specs.fe: none (pooled OLS with Treat and Post main effects)

data_files_note: Exchange-level basis, CME futures, Binance rates, Google trends, VIX shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (Figures_and_Tables.R). code_prescore 2 driven by Treat/Post names and plm 'twoways' regressions on continuous regressors.
